title: Read and collect CI proof only in declared units

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage — Read and collect CI proof only in declared units

**Verdict — Caught.** The maintained authenticated-reader test rejected the fault that let a retired unit through alongside declared evidence.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing authenticated-reader assertion. This check calls for no additional proof or follow-up.

## Promise and evidence

Story `SEED-423#require-declared-units-in-ci-proof` in `.planning/seeds/SEED-423-shrink-the-installed-distribution.md#require-declared-units-in-ci-proof`, plan 795, slice 7. Checked the completed revision `df06d72c5b98d8132a139e1ea0f607cad87d60e5`. The reader must reject a complete version 2 response when any entry lacks a declared unit.

The scratch fault at `dashboard/src/ciProof.ts:114` mapped the raw `legacy` unit to `case` before validating the evidence. All maintained fixtures and assertions stayed intact. An independent call to `readIntentCiProof` over the authenticated response supplied one declared entry with five cases and a second entry with three legacy results. The fault returned both entries, relabeling the three legacy results as cases for the same requested run and revision.

The one-worker backend selection ran only “the proof reader accepts both declared units and refuses a response with one undeclared unit” in `dashboard/backend-tests/intent/ci-comparison-client-wire-validation.spec.ts`. The baseline passed. With the fault, the test exited 1 at line 133. The rejection assertion received a resolved summary containing the relabeled count. After restoring the original bytes, the same selection passed. The detached scratch worktree matched its clean starting state after restoration and was removed.

The test used the locked project dependencies and Chromium on awake AC macOS under `caffeinate -s -i`. Each run set `OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_PROOF_RECORD` to its own path.

```sh
caffeinate -s -i env PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" npm run test:dashboard:backend -- --workers 1 'ci-comparison-client-wire-validation\.spec\.ts$' --grep 'the proof reader accepts both declared units and refuses a response with one undeclared unit'
```

Report and per-run evidence directory — `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-423.sz4Arq`.

## Cost

- **Test runtime.** 24 ms (measured), the sum of three recorded Playwright case durations at 8 ms each for baseline, fault and restoration. This excludes runner startup and the first silent baseline invocation, which had no case-duration record.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human effort measure was recorded during the probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. The host supplied no separate effort measure for this probe.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 258418 ms (measured), from 1795446768878 to 1795447027296 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.


## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision `df06d72c5b98d8132a139e1ea0f607cad87d60e5` | Caught | no follow-up.
